name: Full Service Home Electrics Miami
address: 87044 SW 26th Rd, Miami, FL 33129, United States

reviewSamples.author: Timothy Hightower
reviewSamples.text: Great experience from making plans to finishing. The electrician showed up on time, got the job done quickly, and cleaned up after himself. The quality of the repair was very good. I'd use their service once more.

reviewSamples.author: Roger Hudson
reviewSamples.text: The electrician was very professional, which I liked. They heard my worries and told me about the best choices that were out there. Care was taken to do the work, and the technician kept the area clean. They talked to each other clearly, which made the service visit go more smoothly.

reviewSamples.author: Correo Corporativo
reviewSamples.text: The ceiling fans were installed safely and balanced perfectly. The work was neat and professional, and everything looks great in each room.

reviewSamples.author: Erik Guillen
reviewSamples.text: Good experience with electrical repairs. The expert was punctual, understood what he was doing and was always kind.

reviewSamples.author: Shaina Russo
reviewSamples.text: The ceiling fan setups were safe and properly balanced. The work looks very clean, and each room feels better.

research_notes: Busqueda exhaustiva sin resultado util de fotos propias: (1) node scripts/gmaps_detail.js, scripts/gmaps_photocycle.js y scripts/gmaps_reviews.js contra la ficha exacta de Maps: la ficha solo tiene '2 Photos' segun su propio contador, y AMBAS son imagenes auto-generadas de Street View (streetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com y lh3.googleusercontent.com/grass-cs/...), es decir una vista generica de la calle/autopista (overpass SW 26th Rd), NO fotos subidas por el negocio ni por clientes (confirmado visualmente, ver captura: arboles, autopista, sin nada del negocio). (2) WebSearch 'site:facebook.com' y 'site:instagram.com' para el nombre exacto: cero resultados, no existe Facebook ni Instagram publico localizable. (3) Directorios agregadores (zilodex.pages.dev/zilodex.com, lantern.llc, serviceagent.ai): replican los mismos datos de Maps (telefono, direccion, rating) pero CERO fotos propias; la unica imagen que publica zilodex.com/photos/full-service-home-electrics-miami-miami/0.jpg se descargo y verifico: es la MISMA foto de Street View del overpass, no un trabajo del negocio. (4) WebSearch en Yelp/BBB/Nextdoor/Thumbtack: sin coincidencia para este negocio. Conclusion: 0 fotos reales y propias disponibles (minimo requerido: 5). No es research degradado (todas las herramientas respondieron con datos reales y consistentes: rating 5.0, 18 reviews, direccion, telefono y horario 24h verificados), es un negocio real con presencia online minima (solo ficha de Google Maps sin fotos subidas).
